summary: End-to-end verification of the 'Probar Push' bug fix in the support panel. Backend POST /api/support/schools/{id}/test-push works correctly (HTTP 200, fcm_configured=true, returns owner_email/devices_found/sent). Frontend fix is validated: clicking 'Probar Push' on a school card in /support/schools triggers the API call AND shows a result toast, with NO 'BLOQUEADAS' blocking toast, even though the support device's browser notification permission is 'denied' in headless. No-regression check passed: the owner dashboard still renders the 'Activar notificaciones' button with its status badge.
action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: The password in the testing request (Support1234!) does NOT match the actual password (Socios3009). /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not list the support global account. Consider updating /app/memory/test_credentials.md to add 'spencer3009@gmail.com / Socios3009 (system_admin_global)' so future iterations have a single source of truth.

OBSERVATION (not in scope of this fix, but worth noting): backend curl from soporte to elroble test-push returned devices_found=11 with sent=0/failed=11 (FCM tokens fail), while a subsequent click from the UI returned devices_found=0. This suggests send_fcm_to_devices may be deactivating tokens after failure (probably correct behavior on UNREGISTERED responses). Not a bug for this fix — just heads-up for the main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/pages/SupportSchoolsPage.jsx ~L1108-L1141: the onClick now correctly (a) calls primePushAudio() best-effort and (b) ALWAYS POSTs /support/schools/{id}/test-push without checking Notification.permission. The 'denied'-bound return statement has been removed and ensureNotificationPermission is no longer used in this handler. Looks correct.
backend/routes/support.py L2037-L2116: endpoint returns the expected shape and uses _is_configured() for the fcm_configured flag; logging is good. No issues.

success_rate.backend: 100% (test-push endpoint returns 200 with fcm_configured=true for both elroble and a school without tokens)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Probar Push click triggers POST, result toast shown, NO blocking 'BLOQUEADAS' toast; owner dashboard regression button still present)

seed_data_creation: None. Each test-push call inserts one row into db.notifications for the owner (by design of the endpoint); harmless side effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fully fixed and verified end-to-end. The frontend handler no longer hard-blocks on Notification.permission==='denied'; it only primes audio (best-effort) and always sends the push to the OWNER via POST /api/support/schools/{id}/test-push. Backend is healthy: 200 + fcm_configured=true. To re-verify in the future: login as spencer3009@gmail.com/Socios3009 -> Colegios sidebar -> click data-testid='test-push-elroble' -> expect a sonner toast (warning 'aún no tiene dispositivos registrados...' if devices_found==0, or success 'Push enviado al owner...' if >0) and a single POST 200 to /api/support/schools/{id}/test-push. The 'BLOQUEADAS' string must NOT appear.

rca of the issue.root_cause: Previously, the onClick of the 'Probar Push' button in SupportSchoolsPage.jsx called ensureNotificationPermission() and did `if (permission === 'denied') { toast.error('Las notificaciones están BLOQUEADAS...'); return; }`. This was incorrect because the push is delivered to the OWNER's device, not the support user's device, so the support user's local browser permission is irrelevant to the send.
rca of the issue.fix_verified: Lines 1108-1141 now call primePushAudio() for best-effort autoplay unlock and unconditionally POST /api/support/schools/{id}/test-push. The conditional return on permission==='denied' is gone.

Backend curl -> POST .../{multitest_id}/test-push -> 200 {ok:true, owner_email:'admin_multi_...', devices_found:0, fcm_configured:true}

AND no 'BLOQUEADAS' string anywhere on the page (browser notification permission was 'denied' in headless — the previous bug would have blocked the send, but now it goes through).
